{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check the distribution of species by island
df_cross = pd.crosstab(df['species'], df['island'])
print(df_cross)

# Check mean flipper length by species and island
mean_flipper_by_species_island = df.groupby(['species', 'island'])['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
print('\nMean flipper length by species and island:\n', mean_flipper_by_species_island)"}
